absent: Exact bit widths and shifts for working set node and group fields and bucket scaling and eviction mask values
Production generation based recency and refault behavior beyond the alternate no operation build
Memory group lookup reference counting statistics flushing and per group vector counter semantics
Swap cache allocation lookup input output submission and cluster descriptor internals
Readahead value packing for address window and hit fields and global counters and thresholds

findings.text: A public recency predicate evaluates an opaque shadow handle together with a file versus anonymous indicator and a caller controlled flush request, producing a boolean recent verdict plus an out working set flag.

Public allocation and release helpers manage swap cache residency for folios, including multi order allocation with fallback, conditional release of unmapped locked entries, and batched release of encoded page vectors.
Fault time entry points serve synchronous and asynchronous swap cache reads, cluster oriented readahead, and policy driven selection between address driven and offset driven prefetch.

Boot initialization establishes the readahead cluster default from total memory size, registers a virtual memory control for tuning, and creates a swap attribute group exposing a toggle for address driven prefetch.

Shadow decoding extracts fields from low to high significance in a fixed sequence, first the working set marker, then the node identifier, then the memory group identifier, leaving the remaining high portion as the eviction position, with node identifier resolved to its descriptor.

The classic recency decision scales the stored eviction value by a per type bucket shift, measures wrapped distance to the current nonresident age under a per type mask, and reports recent when that distance does not exceed a resident size summed from selected active and inactive file and anonymous counters depending on fault type and swap availability.

When generation based aging is enabled the recency path delegates to a generation helper under read side protection, while the alternate build of that helper unconditionally reports not recent and performs no refault work.

Multi order swap allocation starts from the highest requested order, retries with successively lower orders on contention or memory shortage, records a fallback event per downgrade, and stops on success, on exhaustion of options, or on unrelated failure.

Prefetch sizing grows with observed hit count, uses adjacency of successive offsets when no hits exist, rounds upward to a power of two granularity, clamps to a configured maximum, and avoids shrinking faster than half the previous window.

Address driven prefetch derives a window around the faulting address based on prior address and hit history, aligns forward or backward progression accordingly, centers otherwise, then intersects the span with virtual area bounds and translation block bounds, collapsing to single page service when the window is minimal.

Offset driven prefetch aligns a power of two sized interval around the fault offset, skips the reserved header slot at the start of the space, caps the end at device capacity, reads neighbors asynchronously while marking them as prefetch, and finishes with a synchronous read of the target.

Address driven prefetch walks page table entries across the computed span, ignores non swap entries, acquires a temporary device reference when encountering a different swap type, issues asynchronous reads marked as prefetch except at the fault address, and finishes with a synchronous read of the target.

After service the per area readahead state records the current address with unchanged window and incremented hit count when the served folio carried a prefetch marker, while clearing that marker and accounting a hit event globally or per area depending on configuration.

Swap device resolution rejects empty entries and out of range type numbers, requires an active registered device, and rejects offsets beyond the device limit, emitting rate limited diagnostics for unknown file and bad offset cases.

Cache read helpers first attempt lookup of an existing folio and otherwise allocate, repeating the pair while a creation race is reported, then submit input output and optionally label the result as prefetch.

Recency evaluation holds read side protection while decoding the shadow value and while resolving and referencing the recorded memory group, releasing before any statistics flush that may sleep, with callers already under protection requesting no flush.

Global swap registration and selection state is guarded by two distinct spin locks for general swap coordination and for allocator availability, plus a mutex serializing activation and deactivation operations.
Exchange of a per slot table value requires the owning cluster lock to be held, relies on that lock for ordering with relaxed atomic access, and validates that the slot index lies within the cluster.
Per processor swap allocation cursors carry a local lock protecting the per order device pointers and offsets held on each processor.
A swap slot table is an array with one atomic word per slot in a cluster, while a companion memory group table holds one short identifier per slot in the same cluster.

Per processor allocation state holds parallel arrays indexed by allocation order, one for device descriptors and one for offsets, together with a local synchronization object, initialized to empty device and invalid offset.

Readahead tuning is exposed through a virtual memory control named page-cluster bounded by zero and a maximum, and through a swap attribute group containing a single boolean toggle named vma_ra_enabled with show and store handlers.

Global swap state comprises a fixed size table of device descriptors indexed by type, counters for active files and available pages and total pages, a maximum size limit, a migration capability flag, a table cache pointer, and a poll event counter plus a rotating device counter.

Recency evaluation transitions from generation check to either delegated verdict or classic sequence of decode, group resolution, optional flush, per group vector selection, distance computation, size summation, and threshold comparison, with missing group yielding not recent.

Swap service moves from device and policy acquisition through cache lookup or allocation with race retry, input output submission, optional prefetch marking and window accounting, to return of the target folio with policy and device references released.

Swap filesystem initialization creates a swap object under the memory object, attaches the attribute group, disables writeback tagging for the swap address space on success, and destroys the created object on group registration failure, with an alternate build that performs no work and reports success.

A recycled group identifier may attribute a shared refault to an unrelated live group, a deleted group causes a negative verdict, and a very old shadow entry lapped by the age counter may produce a falsely small distance and spurious activation.

Requesting zero orders or an order larger than a cluster is rejected, allocation validates creation races by retry, large folios bypass prefetch accounting, and lookups must handle unknown devices and offsets past capacity.
Retrieval of the first mapped extent assumes a non empty interval tree and dereferences the lowest node without an emptiness check in the observed fragment.

The empty table value is zero, the shadow marker equals one, the frame marker equals two with a companion low bit mask derived from its width, the bad encoding sets all high bits while clearing the lowest three, and the zero flag occupies the topmost flag bit.

Frame field width sums base frame bits and marker bits, flag width is the smaller of five and remaining word width after frame fields, count width subtracts the zero flag presence, flag and count masks occupy the top of the word with matching shifts, maximum count is all ones in count width, and the generic swap count shift equals flag width.

Swap usage encoding reserves the second most significant bit of the counter word as an off list indicator with the remaining bits as counter, scan control uses values one and two and four for distinct modes, default priority is negative one, and a table backed by exactly one page is reported through a size equality predicate.
Conversion from a folio to a table value derives the underlying frame number and combines it with caller supplied flag bits through a shared frame conversion helper.

Release of multiple encoded pages decodes each entry to its folio, releases any unmapped swap cache association, expands multi page runs indicated by a continuation flag, accumulates into batches, and drops batched references when full and at the end.
Address driven prefetch is active only when its global enable flag is set and no rotating swap device is present, selecting between address driven and offset driven paths at fault time.
A header inclusion guard macro prevents repeated processing of the swap table definitions within a single translation unit.
Readahead setup selects a smaller cluster exponent of two on machines below sixteen megabytes of memory and three otherwise, then registers the tuning control.
